high_level_description: The image shows a close-up of a person's forearm with a temporary tattoo design. The tattoo features two large flowers, one above the other, set within a rectangular frame. The flowers appear to be stylized and have a delicate, almost ethereal quality, with soft lines and subtle shading. The background of the tattoo is a solid, vibrant pink color, which contrasts with the lighter skin tone of the forearm. The setting appears to be indoors, as suggested by the neutral gray surface on which the arm rests.
